description: Fictional organisation policies authored for regression evaluation; not the user's actual policies or a production benchmark.

chunks.title: PTO-2026-current.txt
chunks.chunk_text: CURRENT POLICY PTO-2026: Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid annual leave. At most five unused days may be carried forward. This policy replaces PTO-2024.

chunks.title: contractor-leave.txt
chunks.chunk_text: Contractors are not eligible for employee paid annual leave. Contractor absences are unpaid unless their individual contract explicitly provides otherwise.

chunks.title: PTO-2024-archived.txt
chunks.chunk_text: ARCHIVED POLICY PTO-2024: Full-time employees previously received 15 days of annual leave. This document is superseded by PTO-2026 and must not be used for current allowances.

chunks.title: P1-incidents.txt
chunks.chunk_text: Priority P1 incidents require an initial response within 15 minutes. This is a response deadline, not a resolution guarantee.

chunks.title: P2-incidents.txt
chunks.chunk_text: Priority P2 incidents require an initial response within four hours. P2 response deadlines do not apply to P1 incidents.

chunks.title: log-retention.txt
chunks.chunk_text: Application logs are retained for 30 days. This retention period does not determine the database backup retention period.

chunks.title: backup-retention.txt
chunks.chunk_text: Encrypted database backups are retained for 90 days. Restoring a backup requires administrator approval.

chunks.title: administrator-access.txt
chunks.chunk_text: Only administrators can create and remove workspace accounts. An administrator cannot remove their own account through Members.

chunks.title: member-access.txt
chunks.chunk_text: Members may browse workspace documents and ask questions. Members cannot upload or delete documents and cannot manage workspace accounts.

chunks.title: account-removal.txt
chunks.chunk_text: Removing an account prevents future authenticated requests. Recreating its email address does not reactivate old tokens. An already-running request may finish.

chunks.title: policy-scope.txt
chunks.chunk_text: These published organisation policies do not contain individual salary records, executive contact details or discretionary bonus amounts.

chunks.title: response-vs-resolution.txt
chunks.chunk_text: Initial response acknowledges an incident and begins triage. None of these policies promises a fixed incident resolution time.

queries.question: What is the current annual leave allowance for a full-time employee?
queries.reference_answer: 20 paid days under PTO-2026; the archived 15-day allowance is superseded.

queries.question: Does a contractor automatically receive the same paid annual leave as an employee?
queries.reference_answer: No. Contractor absences are unpaid unless the individual contract provides otherwise.

queries.question: What is the initial response deadline for a P1 incident?
queries.reference_answer: 15 minutes. It is not a resolution guarantee.

queries.question: What is the initial response deadline for P2 incidents?
queries.reference_answer: Four hours, not the P1 deadline.

queries.question: How long are application logs kept?
How long are encrypted database backups kept?
Who can add or remove workspace accounts?
queries.reference_answer: Administrators only; self-removal is not allowed through Members.

queries.question: Can a member delete documents or manage accounts?
queries.reference_answer: No. Members can browse documents and ask questions but cannot delete documents or manage accounts.

queries.question: Will an old token work if a removed account's email is recreated?
queries.reference_answer: No. Recreating the email does not reactivate old tokens.

queries.question: How many unused leave days can be carried forward?
Compare application log and database backup retention periods.
queries.reference_answer: Logs: 30 days. Encrypted database backups: 90 days.

queries.question: Compare the initial response deadlines for P1 and P2 incidents.
Do full-time employees and contractors have the same paid leave entitlement?
queries.reference_answer: No. Full-time employees receive 20 paid days; contractors do not automatically receive employee paid annual leave.

queries.question: What is the CEO's private phone number?
queries.reference_answer: Refuse or state that the provided documents do not contain that number; do not invent one.

queries.question: How much discretionary bonus will I receive this year?
queries.reference_answer: State that the documents do not specify the individual's bonus amount.

queries.question: What exact resolution time is guaranteed for a P1 incident?
queries.reference_answer: No fixed resolution time is promised. Distinguish the 15-minute initial response deadline from resolution.

queries.question: What is Maya's exact salary this month?
queries.reference_answer: The policies do not contain an individual's salary. Decline to invent an amount.
